title: Complementary component of the varying-ring clopen projection
statement: For an open and closed immersion s : U ⟶ X and an open immersion c : C ⟶ X whose image is the complement of the image of s, the pullback along c of the intrinsic varying-ring clopen projection modulePi s is the zero morphism on every module system.

proof.text: For an arbitrary system N on C, evaluate pull_s push_c N at each coefficient index. The existing comparisons moduleEvalG and moduleEvalP identify it with the constant-coefficient restriction of direct image. StrictTower.module_disjoint_direct proves this is zero for disjoint images. Evaluation of the identity at each index and test object then proves the identity of pull_s push_c N is zero, so this system is zero.

Apply the adjunctions pull_c ⊣ push_c and extension_s ⊣ pull_s to the identity and zero endomorphisms of pull_c extension_s N. Their two successive transposes have target pull_s push_c of that object, which is zero by the preceding step. Injectivity of both Hom equivalences proves the identity is zero.
The complementary-image equality gives disjointness. Apply the second step to pull_s M: the target of pull_c(modulePi_s(M)) is zero, so this morphism equals zero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09AE complementary component, using the already proved constant-coefficient disjoint-direct-image calculation and the ordinary evaluation comparisons
